title: FHIR R4 Patient — platform ingestion schema
description: Starter JSON Schema for the platform's Patient ingestion payload. This is not the official HL7 FHIR R4 Patient schema or a profile validator. Additional FHIR elements are permitted.

id.description: Required by the platform ingestion endpoint; used as the unique persisted resource identifier.

meta.description: FHIR resource metadata; contents are not deeply validated by this starter schema.

items.description: FHIR HumanName; nested elements are accepted without full datatype validation.

birthDate.description: FHIR date; lexical date format is not validated by this starter schema.
